title: Fix the Missing Closing Brace
description: The program should print a message and exit normally.
expectedBehavior: The program should compile and print 'Starting up'.
actualProblem: The function body's closing brace } is missing, so the compiler reaches the end of the file still inside an open block and reports a syntax error.
explanation: Every opening brace { must have a matching closing brace }. Leaving one out means the compiler cannot determine where the function (or block) ends.
